## Project Overview

This sample project evaluates whether an environmental policy changed consumer behavior beyond existing trends.

## Key Finding

The treatment group diverged from the comparison group following implementation, suggesting a possible policy effect.

## Methods

- Difference-in-differences
- Pre-trend assessment
- Sensitivity analysis
- Policy evaluation
